thread:
Anya (Sales): Hey team — AcmeCorp POC asking for our SOC 2 report and wants an NDA + a short bridge/attestation while the report is finalized. They want to start within 2 weeks. Can legal/security advise on what we can share and how fast?
Michael (Legal): We can do a mutual NDA same day if you give me the company contact + billing address. For a bridge letter: we can prepare an interim attestation but we must be careful with wording.
Lisa (Security): We have a SOC 2 readiness package (controls matrix + scope) that we can share under NDA. Bridge letters are fine but timeboxed and limited — we can't claim a completed Type II until the report is issued. What exact controls do they need evidence for? (encryption, KMS, SSO, logging, retention?)
Anya (Sales): Thanks. They called out encryption at rest, KMS, SSO (Okta), and logs/retention. They also want an entry-level sandbox for the POC with synthetic data. Contact: julia.t@acmecorp.com, +1-415-555-0199.
Michael (Legal): Copy. I can draft the NDA now and the bridge letter template. Proposed quick bridge language: ```
This interim attestation confirms that as of <date> Redwood Inference has implemented the administrative, technical and physical controls listed in the attached controls matrix. This attestation is interim and does not constitute a SOC 2 Type II report. Final report expected after completion of the auditor's assessment.```
Michael (Legal): We'll also include a limitation: "for access to staging/sandbox only; no production credentials; access expires in 30 days unless extended by written agreement."
Lisa (Security): I'll attach the controls summary and a short FAQ for reviewers. Quick notes to include in the bridge: AES-256 at rest, AWS KMS with CMKs, Okta SSO with SCIM provisioning, audit logs retained 90 days by default, token K/V cache cleared after 7 days for POCs. We can enable additional redaction on request.
Ben (SRE): For the POC sandbox we can spin up a tenant with restricted network egress and data retention settings. ProvisionBot will create the sandbox request once we have the NDA signed and the contact listed. We'll need a support ticket with the Acme contact to provision.
Anya (Sales): Perfect. Michael — can you get NDA + bridge draft to me by EOD? I'll send to Acme and ask them to sign and confirm the sandbox needs.
Michael (Legal): Yep — I'll drop a doc link in this thread when ready. Also flagging: if they request SOC 2 excerpts (audit firm pages) we need legal approval first.
Lisa (Security): Attaching the readiness doc link: https://redwood-internal/docs/security/soc2-readiness-2026Q1 (internal). Also here's the minimal controls matrix snippet we typically share under NDA:
```
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 (AWS KMS)
- Key management: Customer CMK supported
- Authentication: Okta SSO (OIDC + SCIM)
- Logging: Centralized logs, 90d retention
- Data retention for POC: 7d default, option to disable retention
```
Anya (Sales): Thanks Lisa — I'll include that. Ben — create the support ticket after NDA is signed.
Ben (SRE): Roger. I'll prep the sandbox runbook and keep access scoped.
Michael (Legal): NDA + bridge draft uploaded: https://redwood-internal/legal/ndas/2026/temp-bridge-draft.docx (internal). I'll ping when it's sent to Acme.
Anya (Sales): Sending to Acme now. Will update here once they sign. :thumbsup:
ProvisionBot: New sandbox request created (req-8812) — pending NDA verification.
Anya (Sales): Closing loop — Acme asked if we can add a clause that PII won't be exported from the sandbox. Michael: we can add export prohibition. Lisa: confirm redaction + export ban enforcement on sandbox.
Lisa (Security): Confirmed — export disabled for that tenant and we will enable additional redaction.
Anya (Sales): Great — will report back once signed. Thanks everyone!
